notes: Verification smoke test for protocol v6 on the same truncated window. Confirmed that fixing delta at zero restores the one-standard-error rule: 12 and 8 eligible candidates of 23 at the two reselections, against 1 of 92 under v5. Confirmed no defect in the degeneracy guard. Inspected structural outputs only; no returns or performance statistics were computed or inspected. Excluded from the research trial budget.

Engineering smoke test on a truncated window with an informal retune cadence. Inspected structural outputs only, including schema, probability normalisation and position participation, over 63 realised out-of-sample dates. No returns or performance statistics were computed or inspected. Surfaced that selecting over delta let the inner cross-validation choose a trading frequency alongside a model, which is what protocol v6 fixes by holding delta at zero. Excluded from the research trial budget.

The single confirmatory run under protocol v6. Condition A fails: the paired bootstrap lower bound on the Sharpe difference against always-long O2C is -0.519. Condition B fails: the lower bound on annualised mean excess over cash is -7.32%. Verdict: insufficient evidence of a stable incremental value. The decomposition is the substantive finding - gross timing contributes -3.97% a year while cost saving contributes +6.73%, so the entire point estimate of the excess over always-long comes from trading less, and the timing term is negative. Independent evidence agrees: Brier skill +0.012 and a regression slope of realised return on mu_hat of -0.085. No further model was searched.

First implementation of the close-to-close position rule, using a fixed threshold on |mu_hat - rf| against (1+delta)*c. Exercised in smoke mode only, on the truncated window; smoke mode reports no performance figure by design. No close-to-close return, Sharpe ratio or P&L was computed or inspected under it, and its output directory was removed. It was abandoned because a single threshold prices holding, opening and reversing identically, which is the wrong shape for a c*|delta w| cost function -- not because of anything it produced. Recorded rather than deleted so that the rule change is visible. Superseded by the one-step optimum in docs/c2c_exploratory_addendum.md.
